## About
Universal Autoglass & Tires sits on NE Fourth Plain in Vancouver, Washington. We carry quality new and used car, truck and SUV tires, including specialty and hard to find sizes, along with custom rims to dress up your ride.
We also specialize in auto glass replacement, and our computerized balance stations help get you safely back on the road. Drop-ins are always welcome. Hablamos Espanol.
Our neighbors have left 628 Google reviews with a 4.3 average. Come by and say hello.

## Services
- New and used tires: A large selection of quality new and used tires for passenger cars, trucks and specialty sizes.
- Custom rims: A large selection of rims in chrome, color or custom orders.
- Tire balance: Precision balancing on our computerized tire balance stations.
- Auto glass replacement: Auto glass replacement is one of our specialties.
- Patches: One customer's family has had tires replaced and patches done here, and even brought tires in to put on a horse trailer.
- Brakes: One reviewer came to us to have her brakes done.

## FAQ
Q: What if you don't have my tire brand in stock?
A: We can usually get it for you the same day.

Q: Will you work with wheels and tires I bring in?
A: Yes. One reviewer brought in their own wheels and tires and we were glad to work with them.

Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes, Saturday from 8 AM to 3 PM. We are closed Sunday.
